pages.text: [#](53341a)Older grimoires grouped effects under capacity levels I, II, IV, V, VI, VIII, and XII. The modern edition separates **Potion Reagents** from **World Actions** and prints each accepted ingredient directly from the live brew registry.[#]()
pages.title: Reading the Old Index

pages.text: [#](53341a)A row's **level** is the capacity it consumes; **power** is charged by the altar. Inverted names show what Fermented Spider Eye can turn that reagent into. If an old effect has no living row, its reagent cannot presently be composed.[#]()
